notes.title: Hotfix 01 for Mirage Creative 04a1
notes.notes:
Hi dear Steam users,

I forgot to include some files in MC04a1 Unity project and it may cause an importing error for some Daz assets. 
You need to go inside this folder \Packages\com.morganavr.daz\Editor\Importer\Shaders and remove all files inside it.
Then you need to extract Hotfix01.7z archive somewhere and move all its content inside that Shaders folder. Do it when Unity is NOT launched.

You can get access to Hotfix01.7z in two ways:
1) By sending me a Private Message on Steam forums
2) On my Discord server in #steam channel. To view this channel you need to have "Steam" role assigned to you. You can request Steam role here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1245780/discussions/0/2949250308629065633/

-M

notes.title: Please make a backup of your looks/scenes files in preparation of Mirage update
notes.notes:
Hello dear Steam users,

Soon I will release Mirage 0.4-beta-1. During this automatic update Steam will automatically erase all content inside Mirage directory including your scenes and looks files. On my PC they are located at:
F:\Games\Steam\steamapps\common\MirageByMorganaVR\Mirage_Data\StreamingAssets\looks
F:\Games\Steam\steamapps\common\MirageByMorganaVR\Mirage_Data\StreamingAssets\poses
F:\Games\Steam\steamapps\common\MirageByMorganaVR\Mirage_Data\StreamingAssets\scenes

New Mirage version will save/load user files from C:\Users\YOUR_NAME\Documents\My Games\Mirage folder so all future game updates won't affect your save files anymore but for this update this manual copy/pasting of files will be required.

Best, M

notes.title: Release date of the Importer of 3D characters, hairs, clothing
notes.notes:
Hi dear Steam users,

I wanted to give you an update on the Importer - it is almost ready and I plan to release it somewhere in July 2022. It will be called Mirage 0.4-beta-1 and will feature an Importer (Unity plugin) that can import Genesis 3 Female characters, clothing, hairs from official Daz store. Importing of custom made characters (by copy-pasting morphs files and textures) will be released later.

After the Importer beta-1 is released I will either expand Importer's functionality or will integrate cloth physics module. Probably I will make a public poll to understand what users want more.

Cheers, M

notes.title: Bugfix for a hair
notes.notes:
Build 0.3.5.4140

Bug fixed:
Previously when you position Ebony girl close to the camera and Beach girl further from the camera there was a bug with wrong ordering of hair rendering - you could see parts of Beach girl hair which should be hidden by Ebony girl hair. This bug is fixed now.

notes.title: Hotfix: trying to fix a Loading bug (2). Bought a very old PC.
notes.notes:
For this build I rewrote Mirage source code to previous version of Unity. To the same version that was used in Mirage 0.3 in a hope that it will fix a bug. I did it because users said that 0.3 worked but 0.3.5 - does not and one of the major differences between releases was an upgrade and code rewrite to newer Unity version.

Also, to fix this bug I bought today a [b]nine years old[/b] PC and tested this new build on it - Mirage works there.
That machine has:
* GeForce GTX 650 (2GB RAM)
* Intel Core i5-3470
* 8GB RAM
* 500GB almost dying HDD
* Windows 10 Pro

Please report if this hotfix helps.

notes.title: Hotfix: trying to fix a Loading bug. Attempt #1
notes.notes: Some users reported that a game could not load at start. I looked at their submitted crash reports and the problem was in third-party library from Unity Asset Store (Highlighter around girls bodies). I removed this library completely and rewrote it from scratch with a different visual effect (transparent boxes around girls bodies). It should fix the issue.

notes.title: Hotfix: start a game always in fullscreen mode
notes.notes: Otherwise new users could not find a menu button at the bottom left corner of the screen.
